component.name: Halcyon
component.summary: Desktop widgets and themes for COSMIC

description.p: Halcyon puts a small set of widgets on your COSMIC desktop and gives the whole desktop a coordinated look: wallpaper, colors, windows, dock and panel.
Choose a starter look in a short first-run setup, then make it your own.

ul.li: Six complete starter looks with wallpapers and matching colors.
Clock, date, weather, system monitor, calendar, projects, music, notes and focus timer widgets that never overlap.
Thirteen widget styles, from soft cards and frosted glass to outlines, paper and terminal, with a matching dock and panel.
Reversible changes that preserve your applets, their order, panel position and the widgets you set up.

description.p: No analytics, no tracking, and no account needed. Connecting Google Calendar is optional. Weather uses Open-Meteo and sign-in tokens stay in your system keyring.

ul.li: Keep music progress and elapsed time visible after seeking in browser players.
Prevent normal logout or reboot from disabling Islands in the matching add-on.

description.p: First release with desktop widgets, six starter looks, thirteen widget styles and coordinated COSMIC themes.
